fact: Car 12 moved forward from its start position, prior to the start signal.
offence: Breach of Article 48.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, and in-car video evidence. Although the movement was slight, consistent with previous start incidents, the minimum penalty of 5 seconds is applied.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 12 Moved Prior To Start Signal
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
